digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate Pass-1 finder and model resolution
propositions: Pass-1 finder effective model was downgraded from opus to haiku on 2026-06-27 when _verifier_cfg landed, because PydanticAIRunner.run discarded req.config and forced the runner's downgraded model onto the entire run.

Commit b690 made req.config honored by PydanticAIRunner.run, exposing the plan-review.yaml model_ladder[0]=trivial declaration that should be frontier, so Pass-1 would now silently run on haiku instead of the intended opus.

The downgrade is undetectable in offline tests because FakeRunner substitutes for the live model dispatch, and the gate produces PASS verdicts (not errors) when findings are fewer due to weaker analysis, making the regression invisible in artifacts.

Pass-1 prerequisite bin packing uses cfg.model for context sizing, so moving Pass-1 to haiku's 200k window causes premature context-limit escalation that the ladder can recover from but at token cost.

Archaeology of sidecar records shows 115 plan-review REVIEW_RESULTs on opus before 2026-06-27 and zero after, confirming the regression is real and the correct fix is to restore model_ladder[0] to frontier.

Pass-2 verify and Pass-4 coach must remain on standard/sonnet per the _verifier_cfg design, so only Pass-1 should move back to frontier, requiring a test assertion on EFFECTIVE model at the ProductionBatchRunner-to-pass1_chunk seam.
